sentence: This project builds tools that find modules of highly correlated genes in a network where each connection has a weight.
This project builds mathematical models and software to study how quickly species form when periods of isolation alternate with periods of interbreeding.
This project builds quantum computing algorithms that predict the quantum properties of molecules under thermal conditions found in typical laboratory settings.
This project studies the inner structure of the proton by measuring charged kaon and pion production from hydrogen and deuterium targets.
This project studies how the immune system responds to Lyme disease proteins carried on ultra-small pieces of bacteria.
This project builds deep learning systems that generate synthetic electrocardiogram signals for rare heart conditions and explain how they reach diagnoses.
This project studies how alarm calls spread through colonies of nesting birds and how social relationships among neighbors shape that spread.
This project tries to find and build microbial communities that break down toxic chemicals, using microfluidic technologies to screen many at once.
This project builds tools that find mutations in cancer using DNA sequences read from many individual cells.
This project builds a system that uses cellular base station signals to help vehicles detect hidden vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists.
This project builds computer tools to test whether dark matter behaves as the leading cold dark matter theory predicts, using dwarf galaxies orbiting the Milky Way.
This project studies how hawks change the shape of their wings and tail to turn in flight.
This project builds machine learning software that finds and outlines solar filaments in images and identifies their magnetic field chirality.
This project builds tools that find and fix accessibility problems in software so people with vision and motor impairments can use it more easily.
This project builds simpler mathematical models of turbulent flows that still capture their behavior across a wide range of scales.
